name: blogdrafter
tagline: Drafts and edits blog posts that still sound like you wrote them
description: Carries a piece from a scrappy set of notes through to something publishable: it suggests angles when you are stuck, drafts sections, and tightens what you already have. A stored profile of how you actually write keeps the result off the generic-AI-prose track.
author: daisuke
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
